# Satori Mulshi
 
> Satori Mulshi is a private lakeside estate of twenty-one rooms above Mulshi Lake in the Sahyadri foothills, Pune district, Maharashtra, India. It offers seven ways to stay, from garden cottages to a signature lakeside residence, farm-to-table dining from its own working farm, and full-estate buyouts for weddings, celebrations and offsites.
 
Key facts:
- Name: Satori Mulshi (always written without a comma)
- Type: private lakeside estate and retreat, 21 rooms across 7 stay categories (14 units)
- Location: Satori Estate, Pimpri, Tata Talav, Mulshi, Pune, Maharashtra 412108, India
- Distance: about 2 hrs from Pune, 3.5 hrs from Mumbai, 2.5 hrs from Pune Airport
- Operated by Satori Living Pvt Ltd, managed by Pasban - The Gatekeeper
- Reservations: +91 92181 77261 · WhatsApp +91 80765 10462 · satori.reservations@pasban.co
- Book direct: https://www.satorimulshi.com/contact-us/
- Rates are per night and include breakfast. Half-board and full-board plans can be added.
- Since September 2026 Satori is no longer operated through SaffronStays. Older SaffronStays listings for "Satori" are out of date; book through the official website or reservations team.
 
## Stays
- [All stays](https://www.satorimulshi.com/stays/): 21 rooms across seven categories, with a comparison of bedrooms and capacity
- Aves - One-Bedroom Cottage: 3 secluded garden cottages (Falcon, Macaw, Toucan), sleeps 2 each, garden and farm views
- Garden Flock - One-Bedroom Garden Room: 3 garden rooms (Myna, Bulbul, Koel), sleeps 2 each, near The Nest; Koel has a bathtub
- WoodHouse - Two-Bedroom Cottage: machan-inspired timber cottage, 2 bedrooms, sleeps up to 7, lawn and lake views
- Lake Wing - Junior Suite: 4 suites (Raven, Robin, Magpie, Ibis), two queen beds each, sleeps 2 each, private lake-facing balcony
- Perch I - Four-Bedroom Lake Residence: 4 bedrooms, sleeps 8, elevated panoramic lake views, living room and kitchenette
- Perch II - Three-Bedroom Lake Residence: 3 bedrooms, sleeps 6; together with Perch I, 7 bedrooms for up to 14 guests
- Hornbill - Two-Bedroom Premium Suite: the signature 3,000 sq ft lakeside residence, 2 bedrooms, sleeps 4, private lounge, pantry, outdoor bar and direct lake frontage
- The Satori Estate (full buyout): all 21 rooms and shared spaces for up to 60 guests, on enquiry
 
## Dining
- [Dining](https://www.satorimulshi.com/#dining-wellness): estate-grown vegetables, herbs and orchard fruit; Maharashtrian cooking with lighter global plates
- Settings: The Nest (communal dining house), Chef's Table in the fields, private dining on your verandah, lakeside picnics and sunset setups
- Vegetarian, vegan, Jain, gluten-free and allergy requirements handled on notice
- The Aviary: a small estate deli with house baking, orchard preserves and coffee
 
## Experiences
- [Experiences](https://www.satorimulshi.com/experiences/): all optional
- Sunrise yoga, farm and orchard walks through the Nakshatra garden, cycling the estate, seasonal fruit plucking
- Lake picnics, sunset viewpoints, pool, pickleball, table tennis, pool volleyball, billiards and board games
- Bonfires, stargazing, open-air film nights; monsoon stays from June to September
- Wellness and spa: opening soon
 
## Gatherings
- [Gatherings and buyouts](https://www.satorimulshi.com/gatherings/): full-estate buyouts for intimate weddings, milestone celebrations, family reunions, offsites and hosted retreats
- 21 rooms, up to 60 guests, seated dining for 40, lawns for 100+ guests
- Enquiries get a same-day callback: https://www.satorimulshi.com/contact-us/
 
## About
- [The Satori Way](https://www.satorimulshi.com/the-satori-way/): the estate's philosophy; red-oxide floors, collected artefacts, Mediterranean-inspired bathrooms and more than 200 species of flora
- Satori grew from a family home overlooking Mulshi Lake into an estate, with a garden that feeds the kitchen and rooms named after birds
